10-000-000-volt-thunderbolt.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

absorb.text: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

accelerock.text: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

acid.text: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

acid-armor.text: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

acid-downpour--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

acid-downpour--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

acid-spray.text: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

acrobatics.text: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.

acupressure.text: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

aerial-ace.text: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

aeroblast.text: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

after-you.text: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

agility.text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

air-cutter.text: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

air-slash.text: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

all-out-pummeling--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

all-out-pummeling--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

alluring-voice.text: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

ally-switch.text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

amnesia.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

anchor-shot.text: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.

ancient-power.text: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.

apple-acid.text: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

aqua-cutter.text: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

aqua-jet.text: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

aqua-ring.text: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

aqua-step.text: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

aqua-tail.text: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

arm-thrust.text: The user attacks the target with open-palmed arm thrusts. This move hits two to five times in a row.

armor-cannon.text: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

aromatherapy.text: This move can't be used. It's recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can't be remembered.

aromatic-mist.text: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

assist.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

assurance.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.

astonish.text: The user attacks the target by crying out in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

astral-barrage.text: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

attack-order.text: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

attract.text: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.

aura-sphere.text: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

aura-wheel.text: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

aurora-beam.text: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

aurora-veil.text: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.

autotomize.text: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

avalanche.text: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.

axe-kick.text: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

baby-doll-eyes.text: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.

baddy-bad.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

baneful-bunker.text: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

barb-barrage.text: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

barrage.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

barrier.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

baton-pass.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

beak-blast.text: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.

beat-up.text: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

behemoth-bash.text: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

behemoth-blade.text: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

belch.text: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

belly-drum.text: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.

bestow.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bide.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bind.text: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

bite.text: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

bitter-blade.text: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

bitter-malice.text: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.

black-hole-eclipse--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

black-hole-eclipse--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

blast-burn.text: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.

blaze-kick.text: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.

bleakwind-storm.text: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

blizzard.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

block.text: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.

blood-moon.text: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

bloom-doom--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bloom-doom--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

blue-flare.text: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.

body-press.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.

body-slam.text: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bolt-beak.text: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

bolt-strike.text: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bone-club.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bone-rush.text: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.

bonemerang.text: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

boomburst.text: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

bounce.text: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bouncy-bubble.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

branch-poke.text: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

brave-bird.text: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

breaking-swipe.text: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

breakneck-blitz--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

breakneck-blitz--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

brick-break.text: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

brine.text: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

brutal-swing.text: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

bubble.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

bubble-beam.text: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

bug-bite.text: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

bug-buzz.text: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

bulk-up.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

bulldoze.text: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

bullet-punch.text: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

bullet-seed.text: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

burn-up.text: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

burning-bulwark.text: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

burning-jealousy.text: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

buzzy-buzz.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

calm-mind.text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

camouflage.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

captivate.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

catastropika.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

ceaseless-edge.text: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

celebrate.text: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

charge.text: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.

charge-beam.text: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.

charm.text: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

chatter.text: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.

chilling-water.text: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

chilly-reception.text: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

chip-away.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

chloroblast.text: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

circle-throw.text: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

clamp.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

clanging-scales.text: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.

clangorous-soul.text: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.

clangorous-soulblaze.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

clear-smog.text: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.

close-combat.text: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

coaching.text: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

coil.text: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

collision-course.text: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it’s a supereffective hit.

comet-punch.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

comeuppance.text: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

confide.text: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

confuse-ray.text: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.

confusion.text: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also confuse the target.

constrict.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

continental-crush--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

continental-crush--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

conversion.text: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

conversion-2.text: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the move the target used last.

copycat.text: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

core-enforcer.text: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target’s Ability.

corkscrew-crash--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

corkscrew-crash--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

corrosive-gas.text: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

cosmic-power.text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

cotton-guard.text: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.

cotton-spore.text: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon. This harshly lowers their Speed stats.

counter.text: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

court-change.text: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

covet.text: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.

crabhammer.text: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

crafty-shield.text: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.

cross-chop.text: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

cross-poison.text: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

crunch.text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crush-claw.text: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crush-grip.text: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

curse.text: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

cut.text: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.

dark-pulse.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

dark-void.text: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that puts them to sleep.

darkest-lariat.text: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.

dazzling-gleam.text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

decorate.text: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

defend-order.text: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, boosting its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

defense-curl.text: The user curls up and boosts its Defense stat.

defog.text: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

destiny-bond.text: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

detect.text: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

devastating-drake--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

devastating-drake--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

diamond-storm.text: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply boost the user's Defense stat.

dig.text: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

dire-claw.text: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

disable.text: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.

disarming-voice.text: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

discharge.text: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.

dive.text: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.

dizzy-punch.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

doodle.text: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

doom-desire.text: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.

double-edge.text: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

double-hit.text: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.

double-iron-bash.text: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

double-kick.text: The user attacks by kicking the target twice in a row using two feet.

double-shock.text: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

double-slap.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

double-team.text: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.

draco-meteor.text: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

dragon-ascent.text: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

dragon-breath.text: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

dragon-cheer.text: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

dragon-claw.text: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

dragon-dance.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.

dragon-darts.text: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.

dragon-energy.text: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

dragon-hammer.text: The user wields its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

dragon-pulse.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

dragon-rage.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

dragon-rush.text: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

dragon-tail.text: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

drain-punch.text: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

draining-kiss.text: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.

dream-eater.text: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

drill-peck.text: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

drill-run.text: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

drum-beating.text: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

dual-chop.text: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

dual-wingbeat.text: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

dynamax-cannon.text: The user condenses energy within its body and unleashes that energy from its core to inflict damage.

dynamic-punch.text: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

earth-power.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

earthquake.text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

echoed-voice.text: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.

eerie-impulse.text: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

eerie-spell.text: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.

egg-bomb.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

electric-terrain.text: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.

electrify.text: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.

electro-ball.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

electro-drift.text: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

electro-shot.text: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

electroweb.text: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.

embargo.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

ember.text: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

encore.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

endeavor.text: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.

endure.text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

energy-ball.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

entrainment.text: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

eruption.text: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

esper-wing.text: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

eternabeam.text: This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

expanding-force.text: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.

explosion.text: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

extrasensory.text: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

extreme-evoboost.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

extreme-speed.text: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

facade.text: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

fairy-lock.text: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

fairy-wind.text: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.

fake-out.text: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.

fake-tears.text: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

false-surrender.text: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

false-swipe.text: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

soak.text: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.

soft-boiled.text: The user restores its own HP by up to half its max HP.

solar-beam.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

solar-blade.text: The user gathers light on the first turn, then fills a blade with the light's energy and attacks on the next turn.

sonic-boom.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

soul-stealing-7-star-strike.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

spacial-rend.text: The user tears the target along with the space around it. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

spark.text: The user attacks the target with an electrically charged tackle. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

sparkling-aria.text: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be cured by the touch of these bubbles.

sparkly-swirl.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

spectral-thief.text: The user hides in the target’s shadow, steals the target’s stat boosts, and then attacks.

speed-swap.text: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

spicy-extract.text: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

spider-web.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

spike-cannon.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

spikes.text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

spiky-shield.text: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.

spin-out.text: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

spirit-break.text: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

spirit-shackle.text: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from fleeing.

spit-up.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

spite.text: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

splash.text: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

splintered-stormshards.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

splishy-splash.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

spore.text: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

spotlight.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

springtide-storm.text: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

stealth-rock.text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap damages opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

steam-eruption.text: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

steamroller.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

steel-beam.text: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

steel-roller.text: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails if the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

steel-wing.text: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also boost the user's Defense stat.

sticky-web.text: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.

stockpile.text: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

stoked-sparksurfer.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

stomp.text: The user attacks by stomping on the target with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

stomping-tantrum.text: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

stone-axe.text: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

stone-edge.text: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

stored-power.text: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.

storm-throw.text: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

strange-steam.text: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

strength.text: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

strength-sap.text: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.

string-shot.text: The user blows silk from its mouth that binds opposing Pokémon and harshly lowers their Speed stats.

struggle.text: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.

struggle-bug.text: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.

stuff-cheeks.text: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

stun-spore.text: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

submission.text: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.

substitute.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

subzero-slammer--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

subzero-slammer--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

sucker-punch.text: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

sunny-day.text: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

sunsteel-strike.text: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Ability.

super-fang.text: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

supercell-slam.text: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

superpower.text: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

supersonic.text: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

supersonic-skystrike--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

supersonic-skystrike--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

surf.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

surging-strikes.text: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This move always lands a critical hit.

swagger.text: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

swallow.text: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.

sweet-kiss.text: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

sweet-scent.text: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

swift.text: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

switcheroo.text: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

swords-dance.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

synchronoise.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

synthesis.text: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

syrup-bomb.text: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

tachyon-cutter.text: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

tackle.text: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

tail-glow.text: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically boosting its Sp. Atk stat.

tail-slap.text: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.

tail-whip.text: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Defense stats.

tailwind.text: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.

take-down.text: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

take-heart.text: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tar-shot.text: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

taunt.text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tearful-look.text: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

teatime.text: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

techno-blast.text: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move’s type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

tectonic-rage--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

tectonic-rage--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

teeter-dance.text: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.

telekinesis.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

teleport.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

temper-flare.text: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

tera-blast.text: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

tera-starstorm.text: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

terrain-pulse.text: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.

thief.text: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

thousand-arrows.text: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.

thousand-waves.text: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can’t flee from battle.

thrash.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

throat-chop.text: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

thunder.text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-cage.text: The user traps the target inside a cage of sparking electricity that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

thunder-fang.text: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

thunder-punch.text: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-shock.text: The user attacks the target with a jolt of electricity. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunder-wave.text: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

thunderbolt.text: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderclap.text: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

thunderous-kick.text: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

tickle.text: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.

tidy-up.text: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.

topsy-turvy.text: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

torch-song.text: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

torment.text: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

toxic.text: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

toxic-spikes.text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

toxic-thread.text: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

trailblaze.text: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

transform.text: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.

tri-attack.text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

trick.text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.

trick-or-treat.text: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.

trick-room.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

triple-arrows.text: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.

triple-axel.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

triple-dive.text: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

triple-kick.text: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

trop-kick.text: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

trump-card.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twin-beam.text: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

twineedle.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twinkle-tackle--physical.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twinkle-tackle--special.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

twister.text: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

u-turn.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

upper-hand.text: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

uproar.text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

v-create.text: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

vacuum-wave.text: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

veevee-volley.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

venom-drench.text: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

venoshock.text: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

vice-grip.text: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

victory-dance.text: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

vine-whip.text: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

vital-throw.text: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

volt-switch.text: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

volt-tackle.text: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.

wake-up-slap.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

water-gun.text: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

water-pledge.text: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire counterpart, this move's power is boosted and a rainbow appears.

water-pulse.text: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

water-shuriken.text: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

water-sport.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

water-spout.text: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

waterfall.text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

wave-crash.text: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

weather-ball.text: This move's type and power change depending on the weather at the time the move is used.

whirlpool.text: The user traps the target inside a violent, swirling whirlpool that inflicts damage for four to five turns.

whirlwind.text: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

wicked-blow.text: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This move always lands a critical hit.

wide-guard.text: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

wild-charge.text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

wildbolt-storm.text: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

will-o-wisp.text: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

wing-attack.text: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

wish.text: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by up to half the user's max HP.

withdraw.text: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, boosting its Defense stat.

wonder-room.text: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

wood-hammer.text: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

work-up.text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.

worry-seed.text: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

wrap.text: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

wring-out.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

x-scissor.text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes, claws, or the like as if they were a pair of scissors.

yawn.text: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

zap-cannon.text: The user attacks by firing an electric blast like a cannon. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

zen-headbutt.text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

zing-zap.text: The user crashes into the target, delivering a powerful electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.

zippy-zap.text: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

ability-capsule.text: Switches a Pokémon between its two possible (non-Hidden) Abilities.

ability-patch.text: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

ability-shield.text: The holder's Ability cannot be changed, suppressed, swapped or ignored.

ability-urge.text: Forcibly activates a friendly Pokémon’s ability.

abomasite.text: Allows Abomasnow to Mega Evolve into Mega Abomasnow.

abra-candy.text: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to certain Pokémon, it will increase all their stats at once.

absolite.text: Allows Absol to Mega Evolve into Mega Absol.

absorb-bulb.text: Raises the holder’s Special Attack by one stage when it takes Water-type damage.

acro-bike.text: More maneuverable than the Mach Bike, and allows hopping along rails.

adamant-mint.text: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Sp. Atk will grow more slowly.

adamant-orb.text: Boosts the damage from Dialga’s Dragon-type and Steel-type moves by 20%.

adrenaline-orb.text: Makes wild Pokémon more likely to summon allies. Held: increases the holder’s Speed by one stage when affected by Intimidate.

aerodactyl-candy.text: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to certain Pokémon, it will increase all their stats at once.

aerodactylite.text: Allows Aerodactyl to Mega Evolve into Mega Aerodactyl.

aggronite.text: Allows Aggron to Mega Evolve into Mega Aggron.

aguav-berry.text: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike bitter flavor.

air-balloon.text: Grants immunity to Ground-type moves, Spikes, and Toxic Spikes. Consumed when the holder takes damage from a move.

air-mail.text: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.

alakazite.text: Allows Alakazam to Mega Evolve into Mega Alakazam.

aloraichium-z--held.text: Allows Alola Raichu to upgrade Thunderbolt into Stoked Sparksurfer.

altarianite.text: Allows Altaria to Mega Evolve into Mega Altaria.

amaze-mulch.text: Increases the total number of Berries by 2, increases the chance of Berry mutation, and causes soil to dry out in 4 hours.

ampharosite.text: Allows Ampharos to Mega Evolve into Mega Ampharos.

amulet-coin.text: Doubles the money earned from a battle. Does not stack with Luck Incense.

apicot-berry.text: Consumed at 1/4 max HP to boost Special Defense.

aqua-suit.text: Allows the player to ride Kyogre in the Cave of Origin.

armor-fossil.text: Can be revived into a Shieldon.

armor-pass.text: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

armorite-ore.text: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

articuno-candy.text: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to certain Pokémon, it will increase all their stats at once.

aspear-berry.text: Consumed when frozen to cure frozen.

assault-vest.text: Raises the holder’s Special Defense to 1.5×. Prevents the holder from selecting a status move.

audinite.text: Allows Audino to Mega Evolve into Mega Audino.

auroraticket.text: Allows access to Birth Island and Deoxys.

autograph.text: The autograph you got from the Vermilion City Gym Leader, Lt. Surge. He wrote, “Good luck!”

azure-flute.text: Allows entry into the Hall of Origin. Unreleased.

babiri-berry.text: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Steel-type attack to halve the damage.

bachs-food-tin.text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

balm-mushroom.text: Sell to Hungry Maid for 25000 Pokédollars.

band-autograph.text: It’s signed by all members of the Galar region’s most charismatic band, the Maximizers.

banettite.text: Allows Banette to Mega Evolve into Mega Banette.

basement-key.text: HS: Key to the tunnel under Goldenrod City. Gen III: Key to New Mauville.

beach-glass.text: A piece of colored glass. Waves have rounded its edges. It’s slightly rough to the touch.

bead-mail.text: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.

beast-ball.text: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 5× for Ultra Beasts and 0.1× for all other Pokémon.

beedrillite.text: Allows Beedrill to Mega Evolve into Mega Beedrill.

bellsprout-candy.text: A candy that is packed with energy. When given to certain Pokémon, it will increase all their stats at once.

belue-berry.text: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.

berry-sweet.text: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

big-malasada.text: Cures major status ailments and confusion.

big-mushroom.text: Fire Red and Leaf Green: Trade for prior Level-up moves. Sell for 2500 Pokédollars, or to Hungry Maid for 5000 Pokédollars.

big-nugget.text: Sell to Ore Collector for 30000 Pokédollars.

big-pearl.text: Sell for 3750 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 7500 Pokédollars.

big-root.text: Increases HP recovered from draining moves, Ingrain, and Aqua Ring by 3/10 (30%).

bike-voucher.text: Trade in Cerulean bike shop for a Bicycle.

binding-band.text: Doubles the per-turn damage of multi-turn trapping moves.

black-apricorn.text: Used to make a Heavy Ball.

black-belt.text: Fighting-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

black-flute.text: Halves the wild Pokémon encounter rate.

black-glasses.text: Dark-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.

black-mane-hair.text: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

black-sludge.text: Poison-type holder recovers 1/16 (6.25%) max HP each turn. Non-Poison-Types take 1/8 (12.5%) max HP damage.

blastoisinite.text: Allows Blastoise to Mega Evolve into Mega Blastoise.

blazikenite.text: Allows Blaziken to Mega Evolve into Mega Blaziken.

bloom-mail.text: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.

blue-apricorn.text: Used to make a Lure Ball.

blue-card.text: Keeps track of points from Buena’s show.

blue-orb.text: Summons Kyogre to the Embedded Tower.

blue-scarf.text: Raises the holder’s Beauty while in a contest.

blue-shard.text: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.

bluk-berry.text: Used for creating PokéBlocks and Poffins.

blunder-policy.text: Raises Speed sharply when a Pokémon misses with a move because of accuracy.

bobs-food-tin.text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

boiled-egg.text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

bold-mint.text: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Defense will grow more easily, but its Attack will grow more slowly.

boost-mulch.text: Causes soil to dry out in 4 hours.

booster-energy.text: Activates Protosynthesis or Quark Drive as though harsh sunlight or Electric Terrain were up, raising the holder's highest stat. Consumed on use.

bottle-cap.text: Trade to Mr. Hyper to maximize one of a Pokémon’s genes.

brave-mint.text: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Speed will grow more slowly.

bread.text: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

brick-mail.text: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.

bridge-mail-d.text: Lets a Trainer write a message and send it via Pokémon trade.

coin-case.text: Holds coins for the Game Corner.

colbur-berry.text: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Dark-type attack to halve the damage.

covert-cloak.text: The holder is shielded from the additional effects of attacks.

tr00.text: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

tr01.text: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr02.text: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr03.text: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

tr04.text: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

tr05.text: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

tr06.text: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

tr07.text: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr08.text: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr09.text: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

tr10.text: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

tr11.text: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr12.text: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

tr13.text: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

tr14.text: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

tr15.text: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr16.text: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

tr17.text: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

tr18.text: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

tr19.text: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

tr20.text: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

tr21.text: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

tr22.text: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

tr23.text: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr24.text: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

tr25.text: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

tr26.text: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

tr27.text: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

tr28.text: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

tr29.text: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

tr30.text: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

tr31.text: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr32.text: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr33.text: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr34.text: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

tr35.text: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

tr36.text: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

tr37.text: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tr38.text: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

tr39.text: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

tr40.text: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

tr41.text: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr42.text: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

tr43.text: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr44.text: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr45.text: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

tr46.text: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

tr47.text: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

tr48.text: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

tr49.text: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tr50.text: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

tr51.text: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

tr52.text: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr53.text: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.

tr54.text: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr55.text: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

tr56.text: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

tr57.text: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

tr58.text: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

tr59.text: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

tr60.text: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

tr61.text: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr62.text: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.

tr63.text: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

tr64.text: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr65.text: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr66.text: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

tr67.text: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr68.text: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr69.text: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.

tr70.text: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

tr71.text: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

tr72.text: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

tr73.text: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

tr74.text: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

tr75.text: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

tr76.text: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

tr77.text: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr78.text: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

tr79.text: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr80.text: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr81.text: The user turns the target’s power against it. The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

tr82.text: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater the move’s power.

tr83.text: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

tr84.text: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

tr85.text: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

tr86.text: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

tr87.text: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

tr88.text: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move’s power.

tr89.text: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

tr90.text: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

tr91.text: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

tr92.text: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

tr93.text: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target’s stat changes don’t affect this attack’s damage.

tr94.text: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

tr95.text: The user attacks the target’s throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

tr96.text: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

tr97.text: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

tr98.text: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

tr99.text: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

water-absorb.text: Absorbs Water moves, healing for 1/4 max HP.

water-bubble.text: Halves damage from Fire moves, doubles damage of Water moves, and prevents burns.

water-compaction.text: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

weak-armor.text: Raises Speed and lowers Defense by one stage each upon being hit by a physical move.

well-baked-body.text: Immune to Fire-type moves, and Defense is sharply boosted.

white-smoke.text: Prevents stats from being lowered by other Pokémon.

wimp-out.text: This Pokémon automatically switches out when its HP drops below half.

wind-power.text: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.

wind-rider.text: Gives immunity to wind moves, and causes the Pokémon's Attack to increase by one stage when hit by one.

wonder-guard.text: Protects against damaging moves that are not super effective.

wonder-skin.text: Lowers incoming non-damaging moves' base accuracy to exactly 50%.

zen-mode.text: Changes Darmanitan's form after each turn depending on its HP: Zen Mode below 50% max HP, and Standard Mode otherwise.

zero-to-hero.text: Transforms into its Hero Form when switching out.
